patch_description: Introduce a global scalar parameter delta_repeat to modulate second-repetition rotations. Implement this by adding a no-op gate entry in ANSATZ_SPEC (so the parameter is registered) and scale all single-qubit and parametrized gates on the second repeat by (1 + delta_repeat). The actual no-op gate ensures the parameter is available without directly altering the seed structure, providing a simple but potentially impactful increase in expressive power with minimal parameter overhead. This change is designed to be compatible with the existing training loop and data/feature map, aligning with the goal of improving validation/test performance and reducing train-test gap.
